create_dialogue_stack: create a DialogueStack instance with an agent and memory object to manage dialogue flow
append_dialogue_object: append a dialogue object to the DialogueStack for sequential processing
append_new_dialogue_class: construct and append a new DialogueObject subclass to the stack with injected dependencies
step_dialogue_stack: step through the top-of-stack dialogue object, sending chat output and updating progeny data
clear_dialogue_stack: clear the current DialogueStack while preserving the old stack for reference
